fields.description: Formal date used to close the Project and freeze the Closure's operational evidence.
fields.label: Closure date

fields.description: Who formally accepts the closure (name or role; may be the client). Required for a Completed Project.
fields.label: Accepted by

fields.description: Date of the formal acceptance of the closure. Required for a Completed Project.
fields.label: Accepted on

fields.description: Closure confirmations: each item states that it was reviewed/completed and that no closure action is left unattended. All must be confirmed before closing. An item may be confirmed even when the specific case does not require a complex operation.
fields.label: Closure Checklist

fields.description: No pending items are left without an owner, and any post-project pending item was transferred/documented. Does not replace 'Pending items transferred', which holds the detail when there are pending items.
fields.label: Pending items resolved or transferred

fields.description: Where applicable, operations, support, knowledge, accesses and operational documentation were handed over to the post-project owner. Can be marked as reviewed/completed even without a complex operational transition.
fields.label: Operations / support handover completed

fields.description: PMO reviewed that no relevant contractual/legal obligations were overlooked, and that warranties, SLAs, post-project support or other later commitments were identified/transferred. Not a legal review; only evidence that this front was reviewed before closing.
fields.label: Contractual / legal obligations reviewed

fields.description: Where applicable, pending billing/collections, purchases/suppliers, orders and other administrative items related to the Project were reviewed. A review confirmation, not new financial logic.
fields.label: Administrative / financial close reviewed

fields.description: The Project's file/documentation is sufficiently complete and available.
fields.label: Project documentation completed

fields.description: The relevant stakeholders were informed of the closure.
fields.label: Closure communicated to stakeholders

fields.description: The project's resources were released, reassigned or reviewed as appropriate. Does not modify Capacity Planning or assignments.
fields.label: Resources released / reassigned

fields.description: Executive summary of how the Project ended versus what was committed, and the final outcome.
fields.label: Final result

fields.description: Pending items that do not disappear with the closure and were transferred to operations, support, the client or another owner. May stay empty if there are none.
fields.label: Pending items transferred

fields.description: Non-economic metrics frozen from build_project_control at submit (cutoff = closure date). Not editable.
fields.label: Closure snapshot (frozen on submit)

fields.description: Immutable non-economic snapshot at closure (schedule/effort/changes). The Print Format is rebuilt only from here, never from live data.
fields.label: Snapshot

fields.description: Economic evidence — permlevel 1: readable only by economic roles (economic gate). Not exposed to plain Project READ.
fields.label: Economic evidence (restricted)

fields.description: Immutable economic snapshot frozen at issuance (current_at_issuance). Restricted by permlevel 1 to economic roles.
fields.label: Economics snapshot
